description: This file contains a fake implementation of the IHostApplicationLifetime interface used for unit testing, providing controllable cancellation tokens to simulate application lifecycle events.

classes.name: FakeHostApplicationLifetime
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IHostApplicationLifetime for testing purposes, providing methods to simulate application start, stop, and disposal.

methods.name: StartApplication
methods.description: Triggers the ApplicationStarted event by cancelling its associated token.

methods.name: StopApplication
methods.description: Triggers the ApplicationStopping and ApplicationStopped events by cancelling their respective tokens.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the internal CancellationTokenSource objects to free resources.
